A package absent from internalEdges may import no internal package.
An edge not declared here fails the build.
cmd/ packages are the driving adapters. They are the only packages permitted to
start a goroutine and the only place dependencies are constructed, which is why
cmd is absent from noGoroutineSegments while domain and app are listed.

_comment_bootstrap: cmd/identity-bootstrap performs the single ceremony that creates a realm's first
Principal, per ADR-IAM-001 5.11. It reaches provisioning and keycloak and NOT httpapi:
the ceremony is a command precisely so that no route exists which creates a Principal
without an authenticated caller, and an edge to httpapi would be the first step toward
one. It reaches registration for ADR-IAM-001 5.11 rule 5: the ceremony registers this
service's own resource, which the first call's token must name.
_comment_providerauthority: internal/providerauthority is the projection of Organization's provider:identity-control
grants (TDD-identity-control-006). It reaches no internal package: the inbox guard and the
_comment_organization: internal/organization is this service's client of Organization Control as the provider
authority consumer: the snapshot, the bootstrap mark, progress and the frontier, and nothing
else (TDD-identity-control-006). cmd/identity-provider-bootstrap reaches it and the
projection and NOT httpapi or keycloak: it builds the projection and holds no other
_comment_investigation: internal/investigation serves a provider's reads of another Principal and records each
one (TDD-identity-control-005). It reads the kernel through keycloak's SecurityReader and
seals object handles with internal/securityref, which reaches no internal package: it is
the AEAD codec and nothing else.
_comment_securitystate: internal/securitystate accepts and executes a provider's security commands
(TDD-identity-control-005 §Containment as Built): the kernel through keycloak's Containment
port, and the accepted command's reference through internal/securityref.

github.com/jackc/pgx.reason: no package in this repository names the driver. foundation-platform's db package is the single place it is named, and every signature here carries db.Tx instead, so replacing the driver is one module's change rather than this repository's

database/sql.reason: the pgx pool in foundation-platform is the only connection source. a second one would open connections outside the transaction manager, and outbox.Append would no longer be atomic with the domain mutation it accompanies. internal/identity/provisioning is excepted for its test scan destinations only: platform.idempotency_key.response_status is a nullable integer, so a test that models a stored claim must construct the sql.NullInt64 the driver scans into. no production file in that package imports it, and the invariant this rule protects is the absence of a second connection source rather than the absence of a type name

net/http.reason: only internal/keycloak reaches the identity kernel, and only the composition root serves. an HTTP client anywhere else is either a second path to the kernel or an undeclared cross-domain call, and ADR-ORG-001 plus TDD-identity-control-002 both require that no such path exists. internal/organization is the one declared cross-domain call: Organization Control's consumer routes, as this service's workload, for the provider authority projection (TDD-identity-control-006)
